Here is a relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with mornings for the big sights and slow afternoons. Timings and entry rules can change, so confirm them before you go.

Day 1, Amber side: Amber Fort early, before the crowds. Take a jeep up if the climb is tiring. Then a photo stop at Jal Mahal, and an early evening at Nahargarh Fort for sunset and dinner with a view.
Day 2, old city: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning. Lunch near Johari Bazaar, then a short Hawa Mahal stop. Spend the evening on a gentle walk through the bazaars for jewellery, block prints and juttis.
Day 3, easy day: Albert Hall Museum, Birla Mandir and Patrika Gate for photos. Keep the afternoon free for rest, shopping or a last meal of dal baati churma.

Winter (Nov to Feb) is the most comfortable time to visit. A car with a driver for all three days saves a lot of walking and waiting. Tell me their travel dates and whether they walk easily, and I'll adjust the pace.
